heading: Payment of dividend or interest or redemption or repayment
heading_raw: Payment of dividend or interest or redemption or repayment.
content:
12. The listed entity shall use any of the electronic mode of payment facility approved by
the Reserve Bank of India, in the manner specified in Schedule I, for the payment of
the following:
(a) dividends;
(b) interest;
(c) redemption or repayment amounts 70[.]
71[***]

footnotes.text:
70 Substituted for the symbol “:” by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and
Disclosure Requirements) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2025 w.e.f. 19.11.2025.

71 Omitted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
(Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2025 w.e.f. 19.11.2025. Prior to the omission, the provisos read as under-
“Provided that where it is not possible to use electronic mode of payment, ‘payable-at-par’ warrants or
cheques may be issued:
Provided further that where the amount payable as dividend exceeds one thousand and five hundred
rupees, the ‘payable-at-par’ warrants or cheques shall be sent by speed post.”
